errors.too_large: The pasted data is too large (max {max_bytes} bytes and {max_rows} rows).
errors.too_many_rows: The pasted data has too many rows (max {max_rows}).
errors.separator_not_detected: Could not detect the column separator. Copy the table from your spreadsheet again.
errors.invalid_csv: The pasted data could not be read as a table.
errors.no_data_rows: The pasted data only contains a header row.
errors.no_quantity_column: No column contains quantities. At least one numeric quantity column is required.
errors.no_ingredient_column: No column looks like an ingredient column.
errors.no_valid_rows: No usable ingredient rows were found after applying the detected columns.
errors.no_ingredients_parsed: The ingredient parser did not recognize any ingredient in the pasted data.

warnings.rows_without_number: Rows without a numeric quantity were skipped: {rows}.
warnings.rows_missing_quantity: Rows without a value in the quantity column were skipped: {rows}.
warnings.rows_missing_ingredient: Rows without an ingredient name were skipped: {rows}.
warnings.ragged_rows: Some rows had a different number of columns: {rows}.
warnings.ambiguous_columns: Some columns matched several roles equally and were left unassigned: {columns}.
warnings.ingredient_fallback_taxonomy: No clear ingredient column was found; using column {column} based on ingredient matches.
warnings.ingredient_fallback_shape: No ingredient name matched the taxonomy; using column {column} based on its text shape.
warnings.multiple_origins: Multiple origins were found; only the first origin was kept for rows: {rows}.
warnings.extra_ingredients: The parser returned {count} more ingredients than data rows; the extra results were ignored.
warnings.missing_ingredients: The parser returned no result for {count} rows: {rows}.

notes.dropped_origins: Dropped origins because multiple origins are not supported: {origins}
notes.label_restricted: Label {label_id} bonus does not apply to ingredient {ingredient_id}

epi.label_bonus: EPI modifier: not applied, ingredient has a label bonus (EPI and label bonuses are not cumulative)
epi.no_origin: EPI modifier: no origin provided, defaulting to world
epi.not_found: EPI modifier: EPI score for origin {origin} not found, defaulting to world

distance.no_country: Distance modifier: no country provided for recipe, defaulting to world
distance.no_origin: Distance modifier: no origin provided, defaulting to world
distance.not_found: Distance modifier: distance score for origin {origin} in country {country} not found, defaulting to world

seasonality.no_fresh_produce: No fresh produce ingredients: no seasonality bonus/malus
seasonality.all_in_season: All fresh produce ingredients are in season: maximum seasonality bonus
